title: Cofinal types of topological groups
summary: We investigate the local topological structure of non-metrizable topological groups through the lens of Tukey order and cofinal types. Motivated by recent advances in topological groups admitting an $ω^ω$-base, we introduce the \emph{fineness index}, denoted $\f(P)$, for arbitrary directed partially ordered sets.
